blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: This job has no future.
exercises.why: Некому было помогать ему.* — There was no one who could help him. Note that the order of the words shows the intended meaning. НЕЧЕГО is sometimes used colloquially as an equivalent to НЕ НАДО, НЕ НУЖНО, НЕ СТОИТ (no need to, one should not, is no use, not worth): *Нечего о нём беспокоиться, он скоро придёт. Нечего спать, надо вставать! Нечего было с ним разговаривать!* Memorize also: *Делать нечего, надо начинать работать. От нечего делать мы сели играть в карты. Negative adverbs НЕГДЕ, НЕКУДА, НЕОТКУДА, НЕКОГДА are formed by the same principle as negative pronouns НЕКОГО, НЕЧЕГО. They are used in impersonal constructions with the infinitive of the verb and the logical subject, if any, in… — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 104.  ·  «The direct object of a verb with negation (with не) is often in the genitive case instead of the accusative.» «Conversely, to say 'There isn't...', 'There aren't...', we use the word нет followed by the genitive case.» — DLI, Lesson 27; Wikibooks, «Genitive case».
